最短距離では、途中のものを拾えない

Efficiency removes time and effort. But some friction also produces skill, memory, discovery, connection, and meaning. This essay asks a narrower question than “should we slow down?”: which friction should we refuse to optimize away? 研究を横断しながら、非効率を美化せず、あえて残す手間の条件を考える。
